source_text: Ira furoris Domini facta est; nubes recessit a tabernaculo; Maria facta est leprosa sicut nix. Prius recedit nubes, deinde lepra — etiam si gratia Spiritus adsit, obtrectatio eam pellit. Prior populus blasphemans in verum Moysen Christum amisit nubem; ad nos in montem transfiguratum transit. Timeamus ne male loquendo nubem amittamus.
pass_a_gloss: Wrath of-fury of-Lord made is; cloud withdrew from tabernacle; Miriam made is leprous as snow. First withdraws cloud, then leprosy — even if grace of-Spirit be-present, detraction it drives-away. Prior people blaspheming against true Moses Christ lost cloud; to us onto mountain transfigured it-crosses. Let-us-fear lest by-evil-speaking cloud we-lose.
pass_b_english: [[The Lord’s anger was kindled; the cloud withdrew from the tent; Miriam was leprous as snow >> Bible:Numbers 12:9-10]]. First the cloud departs, then leprosy — even where the Spirit’s grace is present, detraction drives it away. The former people, blaspheming the true Moses — Christ — lost the cloud; it passed to us on the mountain of transfiguration. Fear lest by evil speech we lose the cloud.
